_comment: Every file the two products have to agree on, with its SHA-256. A contract changes with its version, in its owner's project first -
then `python -m arx_tools.contracts --update` here and the identical copy in the other project. See contracts/README.md.

contracts.name: arx-export
contracts.what: history of the original software for arx-free

contracts.name: effort-v3
contracts.what: did the set produce fatigue - rule and shared test vectors

contracts.name: vocabulary
contracts.what: the words a person reads or hears for the fatigue rule (report, coach, live display)

contracts.name: modes
contracts.what: a set's mode (movement x ending x phase), Output and the machine's own inroad scale - definitions and field names; v2 added the ending 'fatigue'; v3: a person ends an Inroad set (the original never ends a set by itself and judges nothing for a hold - owner's own test 2026-09-22), a recommended hold = static/time with a fatigue target (arx-free: static/fatigue), ONE hold rule to come (hold-1)

contracts.name: exercise-coaching
contracts.what: how an exercise is done on the machine - start, path, end, cues by phase, safety points (German + English)
